scope: Experimental GGUF batch product interface; partial independent qualification, four-family release remains incomplete
input: JSON array of1..64 nonempty raw UTF8 prompts; FILE=- reads stdin
output: Counted NDJSON admitted/token/completed/failed events; length-bounded greedy, prediction-first, final predicted token is not forwarded
scheduling: Shared BnGenerateBatch admission/chunk planning/publication/failure and refill logic; maximum16 live requests

dense-bf16.execution: Packed CUDA execution with the common GGUF managed-payload ledger and variable-capacity idle pool; adequate reuse and fenced KV growth/idle reclamation preserve live leases.
dense-bf16.qualification: Two queued canonical129-token requests with64 outputs each:128 complete F32 heads exactly reproduce independent BF16 source expansion; one creation and one reuse; repeated with frontend/tokenizer ASAN/UBSAN instrumentation
dense-bf16.limits: Aggregate payload quotas include shared model, packed coordinator and public/private request storage; the KV quota remains a subset bound. Idle storage counts. Opaque bookkeeping, load peaks and physical RSS/VRAM are outside this scope.
dense-bf16.current_qualification: 1152 normal and1152 ASAN complete full heads exact, plus8 under CUDA memcheck. Includes four distinct live raw-text histories, eight-request cohort replacement, serial reuse, device-budget backpressure, exact quote checks and failed prepare/restart/resize disposal.

flash-bf16.execution: Shared raw expert uploads, joint CUDA FFN kernels and model-owned expert-cache union leases; request-private arithmetic/routing/KV/recurrent/PLE state. Healthy request buffers are retained in a budgeted idle pool and reused after restart.
flash-bf16.qualification: 96 normal and69 ASAN/UBSAN complete F32 product heads exactly reproduce independent BF16 source expansion, including16 live requests, replacement, reversed order,1025-token prefill and129x7+122 chunked prefill followed by decode. Cached fallback reproduces4 heads. Lifecycle/transition tests reproduce7 heads per release/ASAN/memcheck variant.
flash-bf16.current_cache_qualification: 185 normal/118 ASAN complete product heads exact, plus80 traced cached heads and20 matched uncached-control heads. Includes128MiB/4GiB managed cache budgets,16 live requests, replacement, warm reuse, mixed129x7+122 chunked prefill/decode and cached failure recovery.

glm-recurrent.execution: Shared raw expert uploads and joint CUDA FFN kernels with request-private arithmetic/routing/KV/recurrent state; healthy request buffers are retained in a budgeted idle pool and reused after restart.
glm-recurrent.qualification: Captured cuBLAS13.10.0 profile:80 normal and68 ASAN/UBSAN product full heads exactly reproduce original BF16 references, plus12 product heads under CUDA memcheck. Covers replacement, reversed order,16 live requests, and2049-token chunked1024+1024+1 prefill followed by decode.
glm-recurrent.diagnosis: The earlier0/6 comparison used historicalcuBLAS13.1.1 references against the current13.10.0 native binary. memory: All three GGUF profiles and the separate native DeepSeek adapter use the common managed HOST/DEVICE ledger. Per-request/native raw-pool/dense KV subset caps compose with aggregate admission. Idle storage stays charged. Native exact-shape and dense adequate-shape reuse retain their original numerical rules. Load/setup and physical RSS/VRAM bounds are not established.
unsupported: Profile/model-layout mismatch, unavailable CUDA/MKL and unsupported backend weight formats reject explicitly; no implicit CPU fallback
limitations: GLM numerical qualification is specific to the capturedcuBLAS13.10.0 pair and declared chronological sparse profile; historical13.1 values are retained separately

No new performance parity or offload efficiency claim
CPU AVX2/AVX512/NEON and Metal qualification remain pending
